Each figure below sits in a tabset: the figure, then its lineage as chronex recorded it. A step
is one node, however many times it ran; hover a step for its parameters, code version and
flags. The toy workflow behind these figures runs with four planted mistakes, so some steps are
flagged.

```{python}
#| include: false
# Run the toy workflow once, with its planted mistakes, into work/.
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

if not Path("work").exists():
    drive = Path("../toy-workflow/drive.py").resolve()
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, drive, "decorator", "work", "--faults"], check=True)
os.chdir("work")
```

## A figure the pipeline wrote

The heat capacity curves come from the toy workflow's last step, `plot`.

```{python}
import chronex.quarto as cq

cq.figure("results/cv.png", caption="Heat capacity of the toy model", label="cv")
```

## A figure made in the document

This one is drawn here, in the cell: `cq.make_figure` records the cell as a step, so its
lineage joins the pipeline's.

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

with cq.make_figure("figures/energy.png", caption="Energy against temperature") as s:
    curves = np.genfromtxt(s.input("results/curves.csv"), delimiter=",", names=True)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
    for seed in np.unique(curves["seed"]):
        rows = curves[curves["seed"] == seed]
        ax.plot(rows["temperature"], rows["energy"], label=f"seed {seed:g}")
    ax.set(xlabel="temperature", ylabel="energy per site")
    ax.legend(frameon=False)
    Path("figures").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    fig.savefig("figures/energy.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
```
